case_information.customer_feedback_summary: Guests frequently praised the hotel's landscaped outdoor areas, pools, family-friendly atmosphere, entertainment and many staff members' friendliness and helpfulness, with several noting cleanliness and comfortable beds. Criticisms included an outdated rooms/furniture feel and requests for renovation, limited or repetitive buffet choices, occasional pool cleanliness or strong chlorine smell, poor internet, uncomfortable pillows, limited outlets and isolated reports of rude staff.
